title: Chapter 1 — The Song of Beasts and Liberty
content:
Under the dim rafters of the Big Barn, Old Major’s dying prophecy still echoed in the hearts of the animals. Mr. Jones, drunk on gin at the Red Lion, had forgotten to feed the beasts of Manor Farm. Hunger, that sharpest of spurs, drove the cows to break through the store-shed door, and when the whip cracked in the dark, the rebellion erupted not by conspiracy, but by the irresistible thirst for dignity.

By sunrise, Manor Farm was renamed Animal Farm. The Seven Commandments were painted in gleaming white letters across the barn wall, terminating in the golden creed:

ALL ANIMALS ARE EQUAL.

Boxer, the great cart-horse whose muscles seemed carved from granite, tossed his mane and vowed, "I will work harder!" Snowball drew elaborate diagrams in chalk for a windmill that would electrify the stalls and grant every creature warmth and leisure.

Yet from the shadows of the harness-room, Napoleon, the silent Berkshire boar, watched with cold, calculating eyes. Liberty was sweet in the summer dawn, but power, he knew, was sweeter still—and the seeds of betrayal had already been planted in the orchard milk.

title: Scene 2 — Challenging the Elders and the Oath
content:
=== SCENE 2 — CHALLENGING THE ELDERS AND THE OATH ===

Setting: the Big Barn & Windmill Hill. The atmosphere is charged with tension.

Napoleon & Squealer: "We have walked under this cloud long enough. If we do not speak now, the truth will be buried beneath the soil of our ancestors!"

Boxer & Snowball: "Do you dare defy the council? Tradition was carved into stone long before your father learned to walk."

Napoleon & Squealer: "Tradition that suffocates its own children is not wisdom—it is fear wearing a crown. Today, we choose life."

The onlookers murmur. The drumbeats slow, then erupt in a rhythmic cadence that reverberates across the hills.

Boxer & Snowball: "Then let heaven be the judge between your conviction and our law."

With a decisive movement, Napoleon & Squealer turns toward the gathered assembly. The stage dims to an amber glow as destiny shifts into motion.
